title: Shape Worksheets: Building and Drawing Shapes
intro: Teach shape composition with pieces students can move.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Have the student build a larger shape from smaller ones before drawing it. Discuss where pieces meet and how they can be turned.

Ask your student

Could we make the same outline with the pieces arranged differently?

If your student needs help

If the sketch is difficult, let the student trace the completed arrangement first.
